result.question: Compare Apple's services revenue growth rate to its products revenue growth rate over the last two fiscal years.
result.answer:
The provided SEC filing evidence does not include a full-year Products versus Services revenue breakdown for any complete fiscal year, so a precise annual growth-rate comparison cannot be computed directly. However, the available quarterly and nine-month data clearly illustrate the divergence between the two categories.

**Nine-month comparison (FY2024 vs. FY2023):**
Using the nine months ended June 29, 2024 versus the nine months ended July 1, 2023, Products revenue (iPhone, Mac, iPad, and Wearables, Home and Accessories combined) declined from approximately $230,901 million to approximately $224,908 million, a decrease of roughly 2.6% [0000320193-24-000081:part-i--item-1-p004]. Over the same nine-month periods, Services revenue grew from $62,886 million to $71,197 million, an increase of approximately 13.2% [0000320193-24-000081:part-i--item-1-p004].

**Q1 FY2025 vs. Q1 FY2024 comparison:**
In the first quarter of FY2025 (three months ended December 28, 2024), Products revenue was $97,960 million versus $96,458 million in the prior-year quarter, an increase of approximately 1.6% [0000320193-25-000007:ex-99-press-release-p002]. Services revenue was $26,340 million versus $23,117 million, an increase of approximately 13.9% [0000320193-25-000007:ex-99-press-release-p002].

**Total net sales context:**
Apple's total net sales grew from $391,035 million in FY2024 to $416,161 million in FY2025, an increase of approximately 6.4% [xbrl:0000320193-25-000079:us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax:2024-09-28] [xbrl:0000320193-25-000079:us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax:2025-09-27]. Total net sales had grown from $383,285 million in FY2023 to $391,035 million in FY2024, an increase of approximately 2% [0000320193-24-000123:item-7-p001]. Apple's Q4 FY2025 press release noted that Services revenue reached a new all-time high [0000320193-25-000077:ex-99-press-release-p001].

**Summary:** Across the available periods, Services revenue consistently grew at a faster rate than Products revenue. In Q1 FY2025 vs. Q1 FY2024, Services grew approximately 13.9% while Products grew approximately 1.6% [0000320193-25-000007:ex-99-press-release-p002]. A full fiscal-year Products versus Services breakdown for FY2025 is not available in the provided evidence.

### Retracted claims

The following claims could not be verified against their cited sources and were removed from the answer:
- In the nine-month FY2024 vs. FY2023 comparison, Services grew approximately 13.2% while Products declined approximately 2.6%.
